plugins.name: prowodo-tasks
plugins.description: Manage ProWoDo tasks, backlog, sprints, reminders and Daily Resumes from Claude Code. Auto-triggers on task/planning mentions; uses the ProWoDo MCP server.

plugins.name: i3deploy-release
plugins.description: Cut i3deploy releases (ServiceRelease + ProjectRelease, user/technical changelogs) from Claude Code or claude.ai. Drafts from git + session + memory + your task manager, dedups, publishes via the i3deploy MCP server (API key or OAuth).

plugins.name: relations-mcp
plugins.description: Guida ai tool MCP di Relation (Hoopygang) per influencer, campagne e audience analytics. Auto-trigger su domande su influencer/campagne/deal/organizations; usa il server MCP di Relation.
